title: New people who write to an agent do not come back the next day
whatHappens: A new person signs up, writes to an agent and gets a reply, then does not open Beeline again the next day.

fixes.text: Starter agent sends one check-in the next morning
Next-morning check-in is no longer refused as more than one plain message

observations.text: 1 of 16 new people who wrote came back the next day over 28 days.
0 of 8 new people who wrote last week came back the next day; the week before 1 of 7.
1 of 8 came back the next day this week; the week before 1 of 9.
First next-morning check-in run sent 0 of 3. The server refused each post. The fix is live; the next run is 30 Oct 09:00.

Value SQL through 30 Oct, outside: 0 of 5 new writers (23-29 Oct) came back the next day; the week before 1 of 11. Check-in table: none was due 30 Oct, so the fix is untested; first test 31 Oct 09:00 for 1 person. Changes.

Walk 30 Oct: 2 of 3 new signups in the window were team test accounts the team filter misses, so outside counts here may be high. The 1 real new person came back 3 hours later the same day after a game was built.
